_comment: Each entry = one app you want pre-installed in the finished image. 'Source' is a path to the installer on YOUR pc at build time (copied into the image). 'SilentArgs' must be the installer's real silent-install switch — check the vendor's docs. 'RunAs' is usually 'System' (runs during first boot via SetupComplete.cmd) so keep installers that support unattended/system-context installs.
